caption:
Two screens, and Mr Turtle's head is turned to the right all day. Lately only the right side of his neck feels stiff.

When a screen sits off to one side, your neck can spend hours turned one way. Put your main screen straight ahead. If you use both equally, centre the gap between them.

Hybi's 1-minute check: top of the screen around eye level, slow head turns side to side (5 each way), and a position change once an hour. Stop if you feel dizzy or your arm tingles.

Headaches alongside it, or no change after two weeks, is worth an assessment. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio
